Neighbor offsets are invariant only when every extent is at least three; addressability bounds justify signed offset sums. Border partial offsets remain valid coordinates.

Canonical bool, signed background conversion and outer full-connectivity fusion preserve existing formulas and sentinel behavior. Singleton and minimum signed-stride cases remain within existing addressability frontiers.
Typed C-fast SSE2/interior path, subpixel path, header, binder, wrapper, saved golds and execution policy remain byte-identical to shipping dependencies.

Caller must prove nonoverlapping output and valid allocations/descriptors. Existing SDK validation does not establish arbitrary buffer capacity or self-overlap; Python binder allocates fresh output. No expanded alias domain is admitted.

Workers zero captures the existing process-global budget once, with default one and unchanged partition policy. No new worker global or pool. Private leaf and assembled-donor observations do not establish a final genuine whole-product ownership result.
